verbatim_quote.original: i choose R3 too. read the response api docs and make sure you follow them for both mcps servers we have taht used repsonse api.
verbatim_quote.english_translation: I choose R3 as well. Read the Responses API docs and make sure both MCP servers that use the Responses API follow them.

extracted_decision.summary: Fix our own transcript storage instead of migrating to LiteLLM, and make every Responses-API server conform to the OpenAI Responses API documentation.
extracted_decision.rationale: The provider is stateless, so the defect is local; LiteLLM adds no session storage of its own and would not fix it.
alternatives: Switch to OpenAI direct and use previous_response_id with store:true
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Keeps the current provider and the custom code, but leaves server-side session state unavailable.
